`ReadStream.resume()` is **not equivalent** to `fetch(n)`.

- `resume()` sets the stream to **flowing mode**, so elements continue being delivered to the handler.
- `fetch(n)` requests **exactly `n` elements** in fetch mode. If the stream is paused, reading recommences for those `n` items; otherwise, `n` is added to the current demand.
- `pause()` switches to fetch mode and resets demand to `0`.

Thus, after `pause()`:

```java
stream.resume();  // resume continuous flowing
stream.fetch(10); // request 10 elements only
```

Source: [Vert.x ReadStream API](https://vertx.io/docs/apidocs/io/vertx/core/streams/ReadStream.html)
